name: Patterns of culture
trans: 文化模式

name: What influences us from the moment of birth?
trans: 从我们出生的那一刻起，有哪些因素在影响着我们呢？

name: Custom has not commonly been regarded as a subject of any great moment.
trans: “定制”（Custom）通常并不被视为什么值得特别关注或重视的主题（即：它并不常被视作一个值得大肆讨论或重视的议题）。

name: The inner workings of our own brains we feel to be uniquely worthy of investigation,
trans: 我们觉得自己大脑的内部运作机制是特别值得研究的对象。

name: but custom, we have a way of thinking, is behaviour at is most commonplace.
trans: 不过，就“定制”而言，我们有一套自己的思维方式；在大多数情况下，这种行为其实只是非常普通、常见的现象罢了。

name: As a matter of fact, it is the other way around.
trans: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。

name: Traditional custom, taken the world over,
trans: 这是一种传统习俗，已经传播到了世界各地。

name: is a mass of detailed behaviour more astonishing than what any one person can ever evolve in individual actions,
trans: 这种由大量细致行为构成的整体，其复杂程度远远超出了任何一个人通过单独行动所能展现出来的能力。

name: no matter how aberrant.
trans: 无论这些行为多么反常（或离谱）。

name: Yet that is a rather trivial aspect of the matter.
trans: 然而，这其实只是问题中一个相当微不足道的方面罢了。

name: The fact of first-rate importance is the predominant role that custom plays in experience and in belief,
trans: 最重要的一点是：在人们的体验和信念中，个人习惯（即“习俗”或“传统”）起着主导性的作用。

name: and the very great varieties it may manifest.
trans: 以及它可能展现出的极其多样的形式。

name: No man ever looks at the world with pristine eyes.
trans: 没有人能够以纯粹、未受污染的眼光来看待这个世界；

name: He sees it edited by a definite set of customs and institutions and ways of thinking.
trans: 他所看到的世界总是被特定的习俗、制度以及思维方式所塑造的。

name: Even in his philosophical probings he cannot go behind these stereotypes;
trans: 即使在哲学探索中，他也无法超越这些刻板印象；

name: his very concepts of the true and the false will still have reference to his particular traditional customs.
trans: 他对“真实”与“虚假”的概念依然会受到自己所属传统习俗的影响。

name: John Dewey has said in all seriousness that the part played by custom in shaping the behaviour of the individual,
trans: 约翰·杜威曾严肃地指出：习俗在塑造个人行为方面所起的作用，

name: as against any way in which he can affect traditional custom,
trans: 与个人试图改变传统习俗的能力相比，

name: is as the proportion of the total vocabulary of his mother tongue
trans: 就如同一个人母语的全部词汇量，

name: against those words of his own baby talk that are taken up into the vernacular of his family.
trans: 与他婴儿时期说过的那些被家庭语言所接纳的词语之间的比例一样微不足道。

name: When one seriously studies the social orders that have had the opportunity to develop autonomously,
trans: 当人们认真研究那些有机会自主发展的社会秩序时，

name: the figure becomes no more than an exact and matter-of-fact observation.
trans: 这些现象不过只是客观、事实性的观察结果罢了。

name: The life history of the individual is first and foremost an accommodation
trans: 个人的生命历程，归根结底，就是一种适应过程。

name: to the patterns and standards traditionally handed down in his community.
trans: 遵循他所在社区中传统上流传下来的模式和标准。

name: From the moment of his birth,
trans: 从他出生的那一刻起，

name: the customs into which he is born shape his experience and behaviour.
trans: 他出生所处的风俗习惯塑造了他的经历和行为方式。

name: By the time he can talk, he is the little creature of his culture,
trans: 等到他能够说话的时候，他就已经完全融入了自己所处文化的圈子中，成为了那个文化环境中的“小成员”了。

name: and by the time he is grown and able to take part in its activities,
trans: 等到他长大到可以参与这些活动的时候……

name: its habits are his habits, its beliefs his beliefs, its impossibilities his impossibilities.
trans: 它的习惯就是他的习惯，它的信念就是他的信念，它所认为的不可能之事，也就是他所认为的不可能之事。

name: Every child that is born into his group will share them with him,
trans: 每个出生在这个群体中的孩子都会与他分享这些东西。

name: and no child born into one on the opposite side of the globe can ever achieve the thousandth part.
trans: 而任何一个出生在地球另一端的孩子，永远也无法达到那目标的千分之一（即永远无法达到那个目标）。

name: There is no social problem it is more incumbent upon us to understand than this of the role of custom.
trans: 没有哪个社会问题比“习俗的作用”更值得我们去深入了解的了。

name: Until we are intelligent as to its laws and varieties,
trans: 直到我们能够充分理解这些自然规律及其多样性（即各种自然现象的成因与表现形式）为止……

name: the main complicating facts of human life must remain unintelligible.
trans: 人类生活中那些最复杂、最难以理解的因素，或许永远都无法被我们完全弄清楚。

name: The study of custom can be profitable only after certain preliminary propositions have been accepted,
trans: 只有当某些初步的假设或前提被接受之后，对“定制”（customization）的研究才有可能带来利润。

name: and some of these propositions have been violently opposed.
trans: 其中一些提议遭到了强烈的反对。

name: In the first place, any scientific study requires that there be no
trans: 首先，任何科学研究都必须确保不存在（某种干扰或错误因素）。

name: preferential weighting of one or another of the items in the series it selects for its consideration.
trans: 在它所选中的各项内容中，会对其中某一项给予优先权（即给予更高的权重或更重要的考虑）。

name: In all the less controversial fields, like the study of cacti or termites or the nature of nebulae,
trans: 在所有争议较少的领域中，比如对仙人掌、白蚁的研究，或者对星云本质的探索，

name: the necessary method of study is to group the relevant material and to take note of all possible variant forms and conditions.
trans: 必要的学习方法是：将相关的学习材料整理成组，并记录下所有可能存在的变体形式和各种条件。

name: In this way, we have learned all that we know of the laws of astronomy, or of the habits of the social insects, let us say.
trans: 通过这种方式，我们了解了所有关于天文学定律的知识，或者比如说，关于社会性昆虫习性的知识。

name: It is only in the study of man himself that the major social sciences
trans: 只有在研究人类自身时，那些主要的社会科学（如社会学、心理学等）才能真正发挥其作用（或：只有通过研究人类自身，这些社会科学才能获得深刻的理解和发展的动力）。

name: have substituted the study of one local variation, that of Western civilization.
trans: 他们已经将研究重点从对某一特定地方性文化现象的探讨，转向了对西方文明的研究。

name: Anthropology was by definition impossible,
trans: 从定义上来说，人类学本身就是不可能存在的（或者说，人类学的研究是不可能完成的）。

name: as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive,
trans: 只要我们与原始人之间存在这些差异（或：只要我们与原始人之间存在这些区别），

name: ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people's minds.
trans: 我们（指那些自认为是文明的人）以及那些被视为“野蛮人”或“异教徒”的人，曾经对人们的思想产生了巨大的影响（即控制了人们的观念和信仰）。

name: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree of sophistication
trans: 首先，必须达到那种高度的成熟度或复杂性才行。

name: where we no longer set our own belief against our neighbour's superstition.
trans: 在我们不再将自己的信仰与邻居的迷信对立起来的地方，

name: It was necessary to recognize that these institutions which are based on the same premises, let us say the supernatural,
trans: 我们必须认识到：那些基于相同前提（比如超自然信仰）的制度，

name: must be considered together, our own among the rest.
trans: 都应该被一并考虑——包括我们自己的信仰在内。

name: Of men and galaxies
trans: 关于人类与星系

name: What is the most influential factor in any human society?
trans: 在任何人类社会中，最具影响力的因素是什么？

name: In man's early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.
trans: 在人类早期，与其他生物的竞争肯定至关重要。

name: But this phase of our development is now finished.
trans: 但我们发展的这个阶段现在已经结束了。

name: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
trans: 确实，如今我们在应对恶劣环境（或原始条件）时缺乏相应的实践经验和能力。

name: I am sure that, without modern weapons,
trans: 我确信，如果没有现代武器的话，

name: I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
trans: 如果我要和一只熊争论某个洞穴的所有权，那我肯定会表现得非常愚蠢（或者说：我的行为会显得极其愚蠢）。而且，我认为不止我一个人会有这种想法。

name: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito.
trans: 最后一种与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。

name: But even the mosquito has been subdued by attention to drainage and by chemical sprays.
trans: 不过，就连蚊子也因为人们对排水系统的重视以及化学喷雾的使用而得到了控制（即蚊子的数量被减少了）。

name: Competition between ourselves, person against person,
trans: 人与人之间的竞争；

name: community against community, still persists, however; and it is as fierce as it ever was.
trans: 然而，社区之间的对立与冲突依然存在，而且比以往任何时候都更加激烈。

name: But the competition of man against man is not the simple process envisioned in biology.
trans: 但是人与人之间的竞争，并不是生物学中所描述的那种简单的过程。

name: It is not a simple competition for a fixed amount of food determined by the physical environment,
trans: 这并不是一场简单的比赛；比赛中的食物数量并不是由自然环境（即物理条件）来决定的。

name: because the environment that determines our evolution is no longer essentially physical.
trans: 因为决定我们进化的环境已经不再是纯粹的物理环境（即，影响我们进化的因素不再仅仅局限于物理因素）。

name: Our environment is chiefly conditoned by the things we believe.
trans: 我们的环境在很大程度上是由我们的信念所塑造的。

name: Morocco and California are bits of the Earth in very similar latitudes,
trans: 摩洛哥和加利福尼亚都位于相似的纬度线上。

name: both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates, and probably with rather similar natural resources.
trans: 它们都位于各大洲的西海岸，拥有相似的气候条件，以及可能相当相似的自然资源。

name: Yet their present development is wholly different,
trans: 然而，他们目前的发展状况却完全不同。

name: not so much because of different people even,
trans: 其实，这并不完全是因为人与人之间的差异……

name: but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
trans: 但是，由于这些地方居民的思维方式各不相同（即他们的想法和观念存在差异），情况就变得复杂了。

name: This is the point I wish to emphasize.
trans: 这就是我想强调的重点。

name: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
trans: 我们环境中最重要的因素，就是我们自己心理的状态。

name: It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture,
trans: 众所周知，每当白人侵入原始文化时，

name: the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
trans: 最具破坏性的影响并非来自物理武器，而是来自思想。

name: Ideas are dangerous.
trans: 想法是危险的。

name: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
trans: 在过去的岁月里，当宗教裁判所将异端分子处以火刑时，他们对此再清楚不过了。

name: Indeed, the concept of free speech only exists in our modern society because when you are inside a community,
trans: 的确，言论自由这一概念只存在于我们的现代社会中。因为当人们身处一个特定的社群（或社区）时，言论自由才得以实现。

name: you are conditioned by the conventions of the community to such a degree that it is very difficult to conceive of anything really destructive.
trans: 你深受社区习俗的影响，以至于很难想象任何真正具有破坏性的行为或事物。

name: It is only someone looking on from outside that can inject the dangerous thoughts.
trans: 只有那些从外部观察的人，才有可能灌输那些危险的思想。

name: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.
trans: 我毫不怀疑，将某些有害的思想引入现代社会是完全可能的；这些思想很可能会对我们造成毁灭性的影响。

name: I would like to give you an example, but fortunately I cannot do so.
trans: 我想给你举个例子，但幸运的是，我无法做到这一点。

name: Perhaps it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb.
trans: 或许只需提到核弹就足够了。

name: Imagine the effect on a reasonably advanced technological society,
trans: 想象一下这对一个技术相当先进的社会会产生什么样的影响吧。

name: one that still does not possess the bomb, of making it aware of the possibility, of supplying suffcient details to enable the thing to be constructed.
trans: 那个仍然没有掌握这种技术的人，也没有意识到这种技术的可能性，更没有提供足够的细节来帮助人们制造出这种装置。

name: 20 or 30 pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925,
trans: 大约在1925年，如果有任何世界大国收到这样20到30页的信息资料的话……

name: would have been sufficient to change the course of world history.
trans: 这本足以改变世界历史的进程。

name: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one,
trans: 这是个奇怪的想法，但我相信它是正确的。

name: that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
trans: 那些二十到三十页的内容（其中包含了各种想法和信息）有可能彻底改变当今的世界，甚至将其摧毁。

name: I have often tried to conceive of what those pages might contain,
trans: 我经常试图想象那些页面上可能包含些什么内容。

name: but of course I cannot do so because I am a prisoner of the present-day world, just as all of you are.
trans: 但当然，我无法做到这一点——因为我就像你们所有人一样，是这个现代社会的“囚徒”。

name: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or,
trans: 我们无法跳出大脑所习惯的特定思维模式来进行思考。

name: to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside and then only if we are very original.
trans: 更准确地说，我们只能稍微超出常规思维的范围去思考；而且只有当我们真正具备创新性（即非常“有创意”）时，才能做到这一点。

name: Hobbies
trans: 爱好

name: Who, according to the author, are 'Fortune's favoured children'?
trans: 根据作者的观点，谁是《财富》杂志所青睐的“宠儿”呢？

name: A gifted American psychologist has said, 'Worry is a spasm of the emotion;
trans: 一位才华横溢的美国心理学家曾说过：“忧虑其实是一种情绪的突然发作（或：忧虑是情绪的一种剧烈波动）。”

name: the mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.'
trans: “人的思维一旦抓住了某个想法或概念，就会紧紧不放。”

name: It is useless to argue with the mind in this condition.
trans: 在这种状态下，与“理智”（或“思维”）争论是毫无意义的。

name: The stronger the will, the more futile the task.
trans: 意志越坚强，这项任务就越显得徒劳无功（即完成这项任务的难度就越大）。

name: One can only gently insinuate something else into its convulsive grasp.
trans: 人们只能小心翼翼地、慢慢地将其他东西引入它那“抽搐般”的、难以控制的掌控之中。

name: And if this something else is rightly chosen, if it is really attended by the illumination of another field of interest,
trans: 那么，如果这个“其他的东西”被正确地选中了，如果它确实得到了另一个研究领域的支持或帮助（即得到了该领域专家的指导或资源），

name: gradually, and often quite swiftly, the old undue grip relaxes and the process of recuperation and repair begins.
trans: 慢慢地，而且往往速度相当快，那些旧有的、不必要的束缚就会逐渐消失，身体开始恢复和修复的过程。

name: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man.
trans: 因此，培养个人爱好和新的兴趣爱好对于一位公众人物来说是一项至关重要的政策（或：对于公众人物而言，培养个人爱好和新的兴趣爱好是一项非常重要的举措）。

name: But this is not a business that can be undertaken in a day or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will.
trans: 但这并不是一项能够在一天内完成、或者仅仅通过一时的意志力就能迅速解决的事情。

name: The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process.
trans: 培养其他类型的兴趣爱好是一个漫长的过程。

name: The seeds must be carefully chosen; they must fall on good ground;
trans: 种子必须经过精心挑选；它们必须被种在肥沃的土壤里。

name: they must be sedulously tended, if the vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed.
trans: 如果想要在需要时立即获得那些能够带来活力的成果，就必须对这些事物进行精心照料（或：必须对这些事物进行持续的管理和维护）。

name: To be really happy and really safe, one ought to have at least two or three hobbies, and they must all be real.
trans: 要想真正获得幸福和安全感，一个人至少应该有两到三个爱好，而且这些爱好都必须是真实存在的（即不是为了满足他人或社会期望而虚假拥有的）。

name: It is no use starting late in life to say: 'I will take an interest in this or that.'
trans: 人生晚些时候才开始说“我想对这件事或那件事产生兴趣”，也是无济于事的。

name: Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort.
trans: 这样的尝试只会加剧精神上的压力（或：只会让精神负担更加沉重）。

name: A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet get hardly any benefit or relief.
trans: 一个人可能会在那些与他的日常工作无关的领域获得丰富的知识，但却几乎无法从中获得任何实际的好处或帮助（即这些知识无法应用于他的工作中）。

name: It is no use doing what you like; you have got to like what you do.
trans: 光做自己喜欢的事情是没有用的；你必须真正喜欢自己所做的事情。

name: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes:
trans: 广义上讲，人类可以分为三类：

name: those who are toiled to death, those who are worried to death, and those who are bored to death.
trans: 那些累死的人，那些担心死的人，以及那些无聊死的人。

name: It is no use offering the manual labourer,
trans: 向那些从事体力劳动的人提供帮助（或资源）是没有用的。

name: tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon.
trans: 经过一周的辛勤工作和劳累，终于在周六下午有了机会去踢足球或打棒球了。

name: It is no use inviting the politician or the professional or business man, who has been working or worrying about serious things for six days,
trans: 邀请那位政客、专业人士或商人是没有用的——他们已经连续六天都在处理一些严肃、重要的事务了，根本无暇顾及其他事情。

name: to work or worry about trifling things at the weekend.
trans: 在周末的时候，就别去忙那些琐碎的事情了，也别为此烦恼了。

name: As for the unfortunate people who can command everything they want,
trans: 至于那些不幸的人——他们虽然能够随心所欲地支配一切，

name: who can gratify every caprice and lay their hands on almost every object of desire--for them a new pleasure a new excitement is only an additional satiation.
trans: 那些能够满足自己所有的任性欲望、几乎可以得到任何想要的东西的人，对他们来说，新的快乐或新的刺激只不过是一种额外的满足罢了。

name: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion.
trans: 他们徒劳地四处奔忙，试图通过制造噪音和动作来逃避那种令人痛苦的、无意义的无聊感。

name: For them discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path.
trans: 对他们来说，无论以何种形式存在，纪律都是通往成功的最有希望的道路。

name: It may also be said that rational, industrious, useful human beings are divided into two classes:
trans: 也可以这样说：那些理性、勤奋且有用的人被分成了两个阶层。

name: first, those whose work is work and whose pleasure is pleasure;
trans: 首先，那些将工作视为工作、将娱乐视为娱乐的人；

name: and secondly, those whose work and pleasure are one.
trans: 其次，那些将工作与个人乐趣融为一体的人。

name: Of these the former are the majority. They have their compensations.
trans: 其中，前者占大多数。它们也有自己的优势（或：它们也有自己的补偿机制）。

name: The long hours in the office or the factory bring with them as their reward,
trans: 在办公室或工厂长时间工作所带来的“回报”是……（不过原文后半部分内容缺失，无法完整翻译。）

name: not only the means of sustenance, but a keen appetite for pleasure even in its simplest and most modest forms.
trans: 人们不仅需要维持生计的手段，同时也渴望享受各种乐趣——哪怕这些乐趣是最简单、最朴素的。

name: But Fortune's favoured children belong to the second class.
trans: 但那些受到《财富》杂志青睐的人属于第二阶层。

name: Their life is a natural harmony.
trans: 他们的生活充满了和谐与宁静。

name: For them the working hours are never long enough.
trans: 对他们来说，工作时间永远都不够长；每一天都像节日一样美好。

name: Each day is a holiday, and ordinary holidays, when they come, are grudged as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation.
trans: 然而，当普通的假期到来时，他们却会将其视为对这份令人着迷的工作的打扰，因而感到不满。

name: Yet to both classes, the need of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere of a diversion of effort, is essential.
trans: 其实，对于这两个阶层的人来说，都需要一种不同的生活方式、一种能够改变氛围、转移注意力的方式。

name: Indeed, it may well be that those whose work is their pleasure are those who most need the means of banishing it at intervals from their minds.
trans: 事实上，那些将工作视为乐趣的人，或许正是最需要偶尔将工作从脑海中暂时抛开的人。

name: The great escape
trans: “伟大的逃脱”

name: What is one of the features of modern camping where nationality is concerned?
trans: 在现代露营活动中，关于国籍方面的一个显著特点是：露营者可以来自不同的国家，他们可以共同享受露营的乐趣，而不会因为国籍的不同而受到任何歧视或限制。这种跨国的交流与融合是现代露营文化的一个重要特点。

name: Economy is one powerful motive for camping,
trans: 经济因素是人们选择露营的一个重要原因。

name: since after the initial outlay upon equipment, or through hiring it, the total expense can be far less than the cost of hotels.
trans: 因为在购买了设备或雇佣了相关人员之后，总费用可能会远低于住宿费用。

name: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.
trans: 但与人们普遍的认为相反，它远非唯一的解决方案，甚至也不是最优秀的解决方案。

name: The man who manoeuvres carelessly into his 20 pounds' worth of space at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites may find himself bumping a Bentley.
trans: 那个在欧洲众多永久性停车设施中，随意停放自己那辆重达20磅的汽车的人，很可能会不小心撞到一辆宾利汽车。

name: More likely, Ford Escort will be hub to hub with Renault or Mercedes, but rarely with bicycles made for two.
trans: 更有可能的是，福特Escort会与雷诺（Renault）或梅赛德斯-奔驰（Mercedes-Benz）实现车对车的通信（即车辆之间的数据交换或互联功能），不过很少会与专为两人设计的自行车进行这样的通信。

name: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic,
trans: 对于那些持悲观态度的人来说，现代露营装备逐年变得越来越先进，这确实是一个颇具讽刺意味的矛盾现象。

name: a brighter promise for the hopeful traveller who has sworn to get away from it all.
trans: 对于那些渴望逃离现实、追求自由生活的旅行者来说，这无疑是一个更加光明的希望。

name: It also provides--and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon--an escape of another kind.
trans: 它还提供了一种不同的“逃避方式”；一些研究社会现象的学生或许会想以此作为自己论文的写作基础。

name: The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide and the Bellavista,
trans: 现代的旅行者往往是一个不喜欢那些华丽、壮观景致的人。

name: not because he cannot afford, or shuns their material comforts, but because he is afraid of them.
trans: 不是因为他买不起这些物质上的享受，也不是因为他拒绝它们，而是因为他害怕它们。

name: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid.
trans: 尽管他很富有，但他仍然不知道该给门卫或客房服务员多少小费才合适。

name: Master in his own house he has little idea of when to say boo to a manager hotel.
trans: 作为这家酒店的经理，他虽然在自己的地盘上“称王称霸”，却完全不知道该在什么时候对下属说“嘘”（即表示不满或警告）。

name: From all such fears camping releases him.
trans: 面对所有这些恐惧，露营反而让他感到解脱（或：露营让他摆脱了恐惧）。

name: Granted, a snobbery of camping itself, based upon equipment and techniques, already exists;
trans: 诚然，基于所使用的装备和技术，露营本身就带有一种“优越感”或“傲慢的态度”（即认为露营是一种比其他活动更高级、更优越的休闲方式）。

name: but it is of a kind that, if he meets it, he can readily understand and deal with.
trans: 不过，这种情况属于他能够轻易理解并妥善处理的类型。

name: There is no superior 'they' in the shape of managements and hotel hierarchies to darken his holiday days.
trans: 在管理层和酒店等级制度中，没有任何人（或“他们”）能够比其他人更令人不快、更破坏一个人的假期心情。

name: To such motives, yet another must be added.
trans: 除了这些动机之外，还必须再加上另一个动机。

name: The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails.
trans: 当代社会中对汽车的崇拜现象，很大程度上可以归因于汽车所有权所带来的独立感和自由感。

name: To this pleasure camping gives an exquisite refinement.
trans: 正是这种乐趣，让露营活动增添了无与伦比的精致感与高雅氛围。

name: From one's own front door to home or foreign hills or sands and back again, everything is to hand.
trans: 从自己家中的前门出发，无论是前往国内的山丘、沙漠，还是国外，无论走到哪里，一切所需的东西都唾手可得。

name: Not only are the means of arriving at the holiday paradise entirely within one's own command and keeping,
trans: 不仅前往这个度假天堂的方式完全由自己掌控（即可以自由选择出行方式），

name: but the means of escape from holiday hell (if the beach proves too crowded, the local weather too inclement)
trans: 但是，还是有办法摆脱这种“假期地狱”般的境况的（比如当海滩过于拥挤，或者当地天气过于恶劣时）。

name: are there, outside--or, as likely, part of--the tent.
trans: 它们是在帐篷外面吗？还是更有可能地说，它们本身就是帐篷的一部分呢？

name: Idealists have objected to the practice of camping, as to the package tour,
trans: 理想主义者反对露营这种活动，也同样反对跟团旅游（即包价旅游）。

name: that the traveller abroad thereby denies himself the opportunity of getting to know the people of the country visited.
trans: 这意味着出国旅行的游客就失去了了解所访问国家人民的机会。

name: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.
trans: 有人认为，孤立主义与自我封闭是密不可分的。

name: The opinion does not survive experience of a popular Continental camping place.
trans: 这种观点在人们实际体验了那处热门的欧洲大陆露营地之后就被推翻了。

name: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors especially, sometimes exclusively.
trans: 假日酒店通常主要服务于某一特定国籍的游客，有时甚至只接待该国籍的客人。

name: Camping sites, by contrast, are highly cosmopolitan.
trans: 相比之下，露营地具有很强的国际性（即各种文化背景的人在这里都能和谐共处）。

name: Granted, a preponderance of Germans is a characteristic that seems common to most Mediterranean sites;
trans: 诚然，德国人的数量占多数似乎是大多数地中海地区共有的特征；

name: but as yet there is no overwhelmingly specialized patronage.
trans: 不过，目前还没有特别专业化的客户群体（即没有那些对某一领域有深厚专业知识或需求的客户）。

name: Notices forbidding the open-air drying of clothes,
trans: 禁止在户外晾晒衣物的告示

name: or the use of water points for car washing,
trans: 或者使用这些水源来清洗汽车。

name: or those inviting 'our camping friends' to a dance or a boat trip are printed not only in French or Italian or Spanish, but also in English, German and Dutch.
trans: 那些邀请“我们的露营伙伴”参加舞会或乘船旅行的邀请函，不仅用法语、意大利语和西班牙语印刷，还用英语、德语和荷兰语印刷。

name: At meal times the odour of sauerkraut vies with that of garlic.
trans: 用餐时，酸菜的味道与大蒜的味道交织在一起，令人难以忽视。

name: The Frenchman's breakfast coffee competes with the Englishman's bacon and eggs.
trans: 法国人的早餐咖啡，可以与英国人的培根和鸡蛋相媲美（即：法国人的早餐咖啡同样美味）。

name: Whether the remarkable growth of organized camping means the eventual death of the more independent kind is hard to say.
trans: 很难说，有组织的露营活动的迅速发展是否意味着那些更加独立、自由式的露营方式的最终消亡。

name: Municipalities naturally want to secure the campers' site fees and other custom.
trans: 各地方政府自然希望确保露营者能够按时支付场地使用费以及其他相关费用。

name: Police are wary of itinerants who cannot be traced to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls.
trans: 警方对那些无法被追踪到任何已知营地范围或固定住所的流动人员保持警惕。

name: But most probably it will all depend upon campers themselves: how many heath fires they cause; how much litter they leave;
trans: 但最有可能的是，这一切都将取决于露营者自己：他们会点燃多少堆篝火；他们会留下多少垃圾。

name: in short, whether or not they wholly alienate landowners and those who live in the countryside.
trans: 简而言之，无论这样做是否会完全疏远土地所有者以及农村居民……

name: Only good scouting is likely to preserve the freedoms so dear to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout.
trans: 只有出色的侦察工作，才能真正保护那些对每一位童子军来说都无比珍贵的自由。

name: Planning a share portfolio
trans: 规划股票投资组合

name: How does the older investor differ in his approach to investment from the younger investor?
trans: 年长的投资者在投资方式上与年轻的投资者有何不同？

name: There is no shortage of tipsters around offering 'get-rich-quick' opportunities.
trans: 到处都有那些提供“快速致富”机会的骗子（或投机者）。

name: But if you are a serious private investor, leave the Las Vegas mentality to those with money to fritter.
trans: 但如果你是一位认真的私人投资者，那就把那种“拉斯维加斯式”的消费心态留给那些有钱挥霍的人吧。

name: The serious investor needs a proper 'portfolio' --a well-planned selection of investments, with a definite structure and a clear aim.
trans: 一位精明的投资者需要一个合理的“投资组合”——即一系列经过精心策划的投资项目，这些投资项目应具有明确的结构和清晰的目标。

name: But exactly how does a newcomer to the stock market go about achieving that?
trans: 但是，对于一个刚进入股票市场的新人来说，究竟应该如何实现这一目标呢？

name: Well, if you go to five reputable stock brokers and ask them what you should do with your money,
trans: 那么，如果你去找五家信誉良好的股票经纪公司，询问他们你应该如何处理自己的资金，

name: you're likely to get five different answers,
trans: 你很可能会得到五个不同的答案。

name: --  even if you give all the relevant information about your age, family, finances and what you want from your investments.
trans: ——即使你提供了所有关于自己年龄、家庭状况、财务状况以及你对投资的具体期望的相关信息，也无济于事。

name: Moral? There is no one 'right' way to structure a portfolio.
trans: 道德准则？其实，并没有一种“正确”的方式来构建个人作品集（portfolio）。

name: However, there are undoubtedly some wrong ways, and you can be sure that none of our five advisers
trans: 然而，无疑存在一些错误的做法；您可以放心，我们的五位顾问中没有任何一个人会采用这些错误的做法。

name: would have suggested sinking all (or perhaps any) of your money into Periwigs.
trans: 我本会建议你把所有的钱（或者至少一部分钱）都投入到 Periwigs 公司的投资中。

name: So what should you do?
trans: 那么你应该怎么做呢？

name: We'll assume that you have sorted out the basics--like mortgages, pensions, insurance and access to sufficient cash reserves.
trans: 我们假设你已经处理好了所有基本问题，比如抵押贷款、养老金、保险以及确保自己拥有足够的现金储备。

name: You should then establish your own individual aims.
trans: 然后，你应该确立自己个人的奋斗目标（或目标）。

name: These are partly a matter of personal circumstances, partly a matter of psychology.
trans: 这部分是由于个人情况造成的，另一部分则是心理因素在起作用。

name: For instance, if you are older you have less time to recover from any major losses, and you may well wish to boost your pension income.
trans: 例如，如果你年纪较大，那么你从重大损失中恢复过来的时间就会更少，因此你可能会希望增加自己的养老金收入。

name: So preserving your capital and generating extra income are your main priorities.
trans: 因此，保护你的资本并赚取额外收入是你最主要的优先事项。

name: In this case, you'd probably construct a portfolio with some shares (but not high risk ones), along with gilts, cash deposits,
trans: 在这种情况下，你可能会构建一个投资组合，其中包含一些股票（但不是高风险股票）、英国国债（gilts）以及现金存款。

name: and perhaps convertibles or the income shares of split capital investment trusts.
trans: 也许还包括敞篷车（convertibles），或是那些通过资本分割（split capital investment trusts）方式发行的投资信托产品的收益份额（income shares）。

name: If you are younger, and in a solid financial position,
trans: 如果你比较年轻，且财务状况良好，

name: you may decide to take an aggressive approach--but only if you're blessed with a sanguine disposition and won't suffer sleepless nights over share prices.
trans: 你可以选择采取一种激进的做法——但前提是你必须具备乐观的心态，且不会因为股价的波动而夜不能寐。

name: If you recognize yourself in this description,
trans: 如果你在这段描述中看到了自己的影子……

name: you might include a couple of heady growth stocks in your portfolio, alongside your more pedestrian investments.
trans: 你可以在自己的投资组合中，除了那些较为普通的、收益稳定的投资之外，也加入一些增长迅速、潜力巨大的股票。

name: Once you have decided on your investment aims you can then decide where to put your money.
trans: 一旦你确定了自己的投资目标，就可以决定将资金投向何处了。

name: The golden rule here is spread your risk--if you put all of your money into Periwigs International,
trans: 这里的黄金法则是分散风险：如果你把所有的钱都投到 Periwigs International 公司里，

name: you're setting yourself up as a hostage to fortune.
trans: 你这是在把自己置于一个“成为财富的抵押品”的境地——也就是说，你的成功或失败都完全取决于他人的意愿或决定。
